info.title: Fizzlayer API
info.summary: The Fizzlayer Gateway control plane, service status, and sales contact.
info.description: Fizzlayer is the secure connection layer for AI agents. The gateway control plane is the /api/gateway routes: signed-in calls use a Supabase access token (Authorization: Bearer or the fizz_supabase cookie), and fizz-agent uses a registration token (fizz_reg_). Guide: https://fizzlayer.com/docs. Setup in the app is at https://fizzlayer.com/app.

tags.name: Gateway
tags.description: Gateway control plane. Signed-in routes use the Supabase access token. Agent routes use a registration token. GET /api/gateway/jwks is public. Plan limits answer 402. Credentials are write-only.

200.description: Whether the service, its database, and the alert scheduler are working. The scheduler is healthy when its last successful run was under five minutes ago. recent lists up to eight of those runs, newest first. This is not an uptime history.

example.description: The secure connection layer for AI agents

post.description: Stores a row in fizz_business_interest. Enterprise uses it for a sales inquiry. The homepage private-beta form uses it with interest set to "Gateway private beta". The row is not emailed. A post with no company is the retired waitlist and is rejected. Limited per network to stop abuse.

410.description: The request has no company. The waitlist this endpoint used to accept is closed (code waitlist_closed); create an account in the app instead.

get.summary: Whether the shared hosted fleet is on
get.description: No session. Returns available true only when GATEWAY_HOSTED is 1, true, or yes. Unset stays false. The Gleam app checks this before /gateway-hosted.json. Cache-Control is no-store. This does not start the fleet.

get.summary: Search the official MCP Registry for remote servers
get.description: Proxies registry.modelcontextprotocol.io (latest versions, 30 per page). Only active servers with an https streamable-http or sse remote are returned. Text fields are trimmed and cut to fixed lengths; treat them as third-party input. The browser app uses this because its CSP limits connect-src to this origin.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next value from the previous page.

400.description: Search or cursor too long, or holds control characters.

get.description: ES256 keys used to verify client tokens minted by POST /api/gateway/gateways/{id}/tokens. No session. Cache for up to five minutes. 503 signing_unavailable when GATEWAY_SIGNING_KEY is missing or not a PKCS#8 ES256 PEM.

Rendered agentgateway config for the gateway that owns this registration token. Upstream credentials are embedded as backendAuth.key.value. Do not log the body. ETag is the quoted config revision. If-None-Match or ?rev= equal to that revision returns 304 and an empty body. A bad token is 401 unauthorized, the same as an unknown token.

200.description: YAML config. ETag does not end in -redacted.

304.description: The caller's revision matches. Body is empty.

post.description: Stores agent_status, agent_revision, and an optional detail on the gateway. detail is 1 to 300 characters and is rejected when it contains a control character, fizz_reg_, eyJ, or Bearer. The body limit is 4 KB. Send JSON.

get.summary: Multi-tenant YAML for the shared fleet
get.description: One agentgateway document for every active shared gateway. Authorization is Bearer fizz_fleet_, the GATEWAY_FLEET_TOKEN value. Upstream credentials are embedded. Do not log the body. ETag is the fleet revision. Dedicated and stdio gateways are omitted. 503 when the token is unset or the document cannot be rendered.

200.description: YAML config for the shared fleet.

304.description: The caller's revision matches. Body is empty.

post.summary: Shared fleet apply or reject report
post.description: Same body as POST /api/gateway/agent/status. Stored on gateway.hosted_fleet. Authorization is Bearer fizz_fleet_.

get.summary: List gateways, the plan, and the caller's role
get.description: Creates the workspace on first use. plan is the platform ladder (Hobbyist, Tinkerer, Pro, Enterprise). Null limits mean custom / unlimited. phone_calls_per_month is the shared monthly phone-call cap. A member of another workspace sees an empty list.

post.description: name starts with a lowercase letter and then uses lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, at most 41 characters, not ending in a hyphen. mode is shared, dedicated, or selfhost. Omitted mode is shared unless the plan includes a dedicated gateway, in which case it is dedicated. selfhost requires public_url. The response includes registration_token once. 402 when the plan's gateway limit is reached or dedicated is not included.

patch.description: Sets unreviewed_tools to hide or show. hide removes an unreviewed tool from tools/list. tools/call stays denied until the pin is approved.

delete.description: Deletes the gateway and its servers, secrets, policies, pins, approvals, and client tokens.

get.description: has_secret is true when an API key is stored. The key and ciphertext are not returned.

post.description: url is http or https with no userinfo. auth_kind is none, key, or passthrough. api_key is required when auth_kind is key, stored encrypted, and never returned. transport stdio with command and args is only for a dedicated or self-hosted gateway on a plan that includes stdio. A shared gateway rejects stdio with 400 stdio_shared. 402 server_limit or stdio_not_included when the plan does not allow it.

get.description: Runs initialize and tools/list against the upstream server from the API, with its stored credential, so the tools are known before any agent connects. Needs owner or admin access. The server URL must resolve only to public addresses. Servers with auth_kind passthrough answer 409.

200.description: The tools the server listed. Names are valid tool names. Descriptions are cut to 300 characters.

400.description: The URL does not resolve to a public address (upstream_blocked), or the transport cannot be listed.

409.description: The server uses each agent's own token (passthrough), so the API cannot list it.

502.description: The MCP server refused the credential, did not answer, or did not answer as MCP.

put.summary: Allow, deny, or approve a tool
put.description: Upserts one rule. tool_name is * or a name matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$. effect is allow, deny, or approve. notify_channel is log, webhook, or phone. Omitted on an update keeps the current channel. A new row defaults to log. server_id limits the rule to one server. A missing rule denies the call. Phone calls are not placed by this route; fizz-guard reserves the shared monthly cap later.

get.description: status is unreviewed, approved, or changed. A changed pin means the server's description or input schema no longer matches the approved hash.

post.description: Body is {"server","tool"}. server is the server name, not its id. pin_sha256 becomes observed_sha256, status becomes approved, and open pin alerts for that tool are acknowledged. Same transition fizz-guard uses.

200.description: Approved, or no matching unreviewed or changed pin.

get.description: description_preview is untrusted text from the MCP server, cut to 200 characters.

post.description: Sets acknowledged_at. Does not approve the pin. Send a JSON object; {} is enough.

get.description: args_preview is argument key names only, at most 120 characters. status is pending, approved, denied, or consumed.

post.summary: Approve or deny a pending call
post.description: status is approved or denied. Only a pending row that has not expired is updated. An approval is single-use when the agent retries the same call.

get.description: The signed-in preview omits upstream credentials. ETag ends in -redacted. If-None-Match or ?rev= returns 304. This is not the document fizz-agent writes.
Does not include the JWT. revoked_at is set after DELETE.

post.description: name is 1 to 80 characters with no control characters. ttl_seconds defaults to 3600 and must be from 60 to 2592000 (30 days). The JWT is returned once on token.token. aud is the gateway public_url. iss is fizzlayer. A disabled gateway returns 409 gateway_disabled. 503 signing_unavailable when GATEWAY_SIGNING_KEY is missing.

delete.description: Sets revoked_at. fizz-guard reads that column. This does not reload the YAML.

post.description: Returns the new registration_token once. The previous token stops working. Send a JSON object.

supabaseAccess.description: Supabase access token for the signed-in user. Send Authorization: Bearer. This is not an agent token (fizz_agent_) and not a gateway registration token (fizz_reg_).

supabaseCookie.name: fizz_supabase
supabaseCookie.description: HttpOnly cookie set by POST /api/auth. Same Supabase access token as supabaseAccess. Path is /api. Either this cookie or the bearer token authorizes a signed-in gateway route.

registrationToken.description: Gateway registration token. The value starts with fizz_reg_ and is 64 hex characters after that prefix. It is returned once when a gateway is created or the token is rotated. Send Authorization: Bearer. There is no cookie form.

registration_token.description: fizz_reg_ plus 64 hex characters. Shown once.

url.description: Remote URL, or the stdio command.

command.description: stdio only. Sent as the command instead of url.

description_preview.description: Untrusted text from the MCP server.

InvalidRequest.description: A field is missing or a value doesn't fit.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Wait and retry.

GatewayInvalid.description: The body or a field was rejected (invalid_request, or stdio_shared).

GatewaySignIn.description: No Supabase access token. Code unauthorized. Message: Sign in to continue.

GatewayAgentUnauthorized.description: Registration token missing or rejected. Code unauthorized.

GatewayForbidden.description: The caller is a member. Code forbidden. Only an owner or admin can change the gateway.

GatewayMissing.description: No such gateway in this workspace, or the id is not a UUID. Code not_found. Another workspace looks the same.

GatewayMethod.description: That method is not supported on this route. Code method_not_allowed.

GatewayPayment.description: Over a plan limit. HTTP 402. Codes: gateway_limit, server_limit, stdio_not_included, dedicated_not_included, seat_limit.

GatewayConflict.description: Name already used (409 conflict) or the gateway is disabled (409 gateway_disabled).

GatewayTooLarge.description: JSON body over 32 KB on a signed-in write, or over 4 KB on agent status. Code invalid_request.

GatewayJson.description: Content-Type is not JSON. Code unsupported_media_type.

GatewayRateLimited.description: Too many gateway requests. Code rate_limited. Retry-After: 60.

GatewayUnavailable.description: 503. Codes: database_unavailable, signing_unavailable, encryption_unavailable, missing_secret, unavailable. The gateway migrations or GATEWAY_SIGNING_KEY / GATEWAY_SECRET_KEY may be missing.
